purpose: Working deployable opinionated reference application; research-driven core capability, reliability, usability and reproducibility improvements. Not a competing commercial SaaS or a benchmark-score target.
publication_boundary: Explicit public allowlist: published sources and authorized maintainer engineering summaries only. Original private case verdicts/discussions/artifacts are not exported.

records.title: Keep explicit document scope hard across retrieval branches
records.research_source: Unpublished retrieval research retained privately. https://aidemos.com/tools/futuresmart-agent is older platform context, not the same execution.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: Explicit scope could broaden after empty retrieval and return an excluded answer-bearing document.
records.root_cause: Scope was being treated as a relevance hint along fallback paths; unimplemented filter keys could also be silently ignored.
records.engineering_decision: Treat explicit object IDs as a hard boundary, including empty/unknown/deleted/foreign IDs. Reject unsupported filters instead of pretending to honor them.
records.implementation: Kept scope in dense/hybrid/queryless paths; added request validation. Internal relevance expansion remains an explicit separate opt-in.
records.validation: Real-Qdrant focused scope contracts, independent staged/direct API controls, a fresh cited browser answer and changed-production controls passed.
records.limits: The historical arbitrary metadata-filter interface is not now implemented. Rejecting unsupported filters is safer but does not turn that historical test into a benchmark Pass. Not a full RAG rerun.

records.title: Expose recorded extraction context without inventing history
records.benchmark: None (researcher report and maintainer reproduction, not a benchmark scenario)
records.research_source: Unpublished researcher report and a maintainer schema-evolution reproduction; original report details withheld.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: A blank old field did not explain whether extraction had processed that field. Current field definitions could be confused with the historical extraction contract.
records.root_cause: Existing successful enrichment events recorded some processed field names, but table/CSV consumers lacked that context; complete historical field definitions were not stored.
records.engineering_decision: Add bounded, separate extraction context. Keep missing history/definition history unknown; do not backfill invented schemas or rewrite existing values.
records.implementation: Added context to tabular APIs and CSV from existing successful events, with timeout/failure fallback to unknown.
records.validation: Focused context/paging/failure tests and independent staged/production API/browser/CSV checks passed. Existing exported columns and cell strings were preserved; context was additive.
records.limits: This is observability and schema-history honesty, not improved extraction accuracy, exact provenance, reprocessing, or full historical schema versioning.

records.title: Record a nonreproducing nested-field issue instead of claiming a fix
records.research_source: Unpublished extraction research; historical schema details unavailable. Raw document/case data remain private.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: Historical evidence had omitted source-present fields, but did not preserve the exact saved schema needed to attribute the loss.
records.root_cause: Unknown historically: configuration omission, schema construction, model output and serialization were not distinguished by the retained record.
records.engineering_decision: Replay the original document with an explicitly NEW recorded schema. If that works, preserve the historical uncertainty and do not patch a presumed OCR/extraction bug.
records.implementation: No extraction/model code change. Added a private reproduction record and retained the original failure.
records.validation: A current browser/API/source/export replay captured all required nested fields under the new schema.
records.limits: Not an exact historical replay, broad extraction score, or proof that all nested documents work. Historical baseline verdict stays unchanged.

records.title: Exhaustive collection answers need complete record accounting
records.research_source: Unpublished collection-query feedback plus a later maintainer reproduction on a separately frozen population.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: An exhaustive question omitted registered objects; answer and chart did not account for the same complete object set.
records.root_cause: Bounded retrieval and answer construction do not establish exhaustive coverage. The exact historical runtime/configuration is unknown; current first loss was observed in answer output, not assumed to be parsing.
records.engineering_decision: Account for registered object IDs, qualify partial results, and keep numeric/currency aggregation honest. Preserve duplicates as records unless explicitly asked to deduplicate.
records.implementation: A separate candidate explores authoritative typed-record handling and explicit coverage.
records.validation: Current failure evidence and focused candidate work were retained. Independent candidate browser acceptance and production release were not completed before work paused.
records.limits: No completeness/currency fix accepted and no benchmark result changed. A correct threshold query does not establish correctness for an exhaustive follow-up.

records.title: Keep the usable UI and frontend-independent service together
records.research_source: Maintainer installation and service-boundary review, not an extraction benchmark.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: A service guide and sibling-worker dependencies did not provide a coherent one-repository application.
records.root_cause: Deployment and source ownership did not match the complete product users needed to install.
records.engineering_decision: Keep UI, API, required worker, opinionated datastores and deployment guidance together. API users can stop the frontend and use the same ingestion/retrieval/chat engine.
records.implementation: Consolidated source and supported installation, service example and deployment documentation.
records.validation: Fresh-clone UI/API and frontend-stopped ingestion/search/chat checks, source retrieval, original-byte download and restart/persistence were independently checked.
records.limits: No general OCR/answer-accuracy or load-capacity claim; no separate duplicate library engine introduced.

records.title: Do not add learning and correction workflows just to fill capability rows
records.research_source: Project-purpose decision; private capability findings remain preserved separately.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: A correct zero-shot classification or a working ordinary CSV export does not demonstrate example-based learning or corrected-value delivery.
records.root_cause: Those are different product capabilities with different validation requirements.
records.engineering_decision: Defer labeled-output learning, scalar/set correction and corrected-delivery workflows while prioritizing core extraction/retrieval reliability and reproducibility. Do not claim they are implemented.
records.implementation: Documentation decision only, with no runtime/model change.
records.validation: Private research records remain unchanged; public history claims no benchmark upgrade.
records.limits: Deferred is a scope decision, not a correctness Pass. Revisit only with a concrete core-product need and held-out validation.

records.title: Keep source provenance and search confidence as separate open problems
records.benchmark: Structured Document Extraction and Managed RAG, recorded separately
records.research_source: Published platform review is general context; detailed research provenance is unpublished.
records.historical_benchmark_result: Not publicly verifiable: case-level source is unpublished; no new benchmark verdict
records.observed_failure: A first matching text location is not a guaranteed field-level source span. A high retrieval rank is not proof that an answer exists.
records.root_cause: Ranking, source matching, extraction context and claim support serve different contracts.
records.engineering_decision: Do not relabel the extraction-context release as precise field provenance, a confidence-calibration fix or support for all document structures.
records.implementation: No new capability implemented; preserve the gaps and validation prerequisites.
records.validation: Current source/report review only; no new product requests or benchmark reruns.
records.limits: Precise claim/field evidence, confidence calibration and untested complex documents remain unverified.
